definitions: A name of God in the Old Testament, a rendering of the ineffable Hebrew name YHWH.
The personal name of God in the Bible, as used by Jehovah's Witnesses.
examples: Jehovah is often referred to as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Many hymns praise Jehovah for his creation.
Jehovah's Witnesses believe Jehovah is the one true God.
